title: Literal instruction sequence
statement: For a Boolean literal consisting of a variable and a truth-value sign, its program is the four-instruction list that first prints the vertex associated with the variable, then outputs true, false, and the literal’s sign, in that order.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a Boolean literal over natural-number variables
caveat: The snippet uses an upstream vertex-assignment function whose definition is not included, so its precise meaning cannot be specified here.
